coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 ARIA 这一种 128 位分组密码：128/192/256 位密钥、12/14/16 轮、FO/FE 轮函数、SL1/SL2 与 SB1..SB4、A 扩散层、KL/KR 与 CK 密钥调度、W0..W3、ek/dk、RFC 5794 附录 A 的三组向量和 128 位中间值、TLS 与 OID 使用；不把 AES、Camellia、SEED、TLS 协议或工作模式并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the ARIA 128-bit block cipher: 128/192/256-bit keys, 12/14/16 rounds, FO/FE round functions, SL1/SL2 and SB1..SB4, the A diffusion layer, the KL/KR and CK key schedule, W0..W3, ek/dk, the three Appendix A vectors and 128-bit intermediates, TLS and OID use. It does not absorb AES, Camellia, SEED, the TLS protocol, modes of operation or the whole library.
